payload.reason: The evidence provides specific downstream tasks analyzed in the context of DistilBERT's performance, including sentiment classification and question answering, as well as evaluations on the GLUE benchmark.

claims.text: The downstream tasks analyzed include sentiment classification (IMDb) and question answering (SQuAD v1.1).
DistilBERT was evaluated on the General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) benchmark, which consists of 9 datasets for natural language understanding tasks.
DistilBERT's performance was compared to BERT and ELMo across various tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in general language understanding.
